右手笔直竖握的一柄雪亮长剑
左手掌心微扬，兼具坦荡邀约与清晰边界
高空流动的云岚、飞鸟与蝶纹石雕，象征清澈理智

en: Poised silver-eyed Queen seated in crisp three-quarter profile on a high carved stone throne above windswept clouds
Exactly one straight, gleaming engraved silver-and-gold sword held vertically in her right hand
Left hand lifted openly in calm, unmistakable discernment and boundary
Cool moonlight ivory, storm-slate silver, and razor-clean antique gold linework with nocturnal moths etched into the throne
zh: 端坐于云岚高处雕花石座、侧颜清冷敏锐的王后
右手笔直竖握的一柄铭刻金纹的雪亮银剑
左手舒展微扬，展现冷静透彻的裁断与边界感
月白高光、风暴银灰与利落古金刻线，石座浮雕夜蛾与星云

core.en: Queen of Swords calls for crisp, honest clarity: cut through polite fog, name facts plainly, and enforce fair boundaries without cruelty or guilt.
core.zh: 宝剑王后要求清晰直接的判断：剥离客套与模糊地带，如实说出事实，在不伤人也不委屈自己的前提下立住公平边界。

message.en: Say the true thing cleanly and simply; clarity is kinder right now than cushioning the facts.
message.zh: 把真话简明干脆地说出来；此刻的坦诚清晰，比绕弯子照顾情绪更善意。

foundation.en: A past lesson, loss, or sharp realization taught you to see patterns quickly and never trade truth for flattery.
foundation.zh: 过往的历练或清醒时刻教会了你一眼看穿本质，不再拿事实去换表面迎合。

present.en: You have the intellectual distance to assess this objectively; separate verified facts from anxious stories.
present.zh: 你现在具备客观审视的冷静距离；把已核实的事实与焦虑脑补彻底分开。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is sharp editorial judgment—knowing exactly what to cut, what question to ask, and where to draw the line.
resource.zh: 你最强的资本是精准的删减与判断力——知道该剪掉什么、该问哪句关键问题、边界画在哪里。

challenge.en: Even upright, Queen of Swords in a challenge slot asks whether protective detachment or bluntness is making an ally feel interrogated rather than heard.
challenge.zh: 落在阻碍位时，正位宝剑王后提醒你留意：为了自保而保持的抽离或过于锋利的措辞，是否让同路人感到像在受审？

action.en: Write down the exact terms, ask the direct clarifying question, and cut one ambiguous obligation cleanly.
action.zh: 把确切条款写明白，直接抛出那个澄清问题，干脆剪掉一件含糊不清的负担。

outcome.en: The fog lifts into clean air: an honest agreement, firm boundary, or decisive verdict restores your self-respect and momentum.
outcome.zh: 迷雾散成清朗空气：一份坦诚共识、稳固边界或果断裁决，让你重新握回主动权。

advice.en: Be direct without being cold—hold the sword straight so truth clears the path rather than wounds for sport.
advice.zh: 直率而不刻薄——把剑握直是为了劈开迷雾，而不是借锋利泄愤。

general.en: Independent judgment and plain speech serve you best. Strip away assumptions, check the evidence directly, and set clean boundaries.
general.zh: 宝剑王后正位提示独立判断与直白沟通此刻最有效。剥除想当然的猜测与客套，直接核对可验证的事实，并划出清爽明确的边界。

love.en: In love, Queen of Swords values candid adult conversation over mind-reading. State your needs and deal-breakers calmly; genuine closeness thrives on honesty, not guessing games.
love.zh: 在感情里，宝剑王后看重成年人之间坦诚直白的对话而非互相猜心。平静说出需求与底线，真正长久的亲密建立在诚实之上。

career.en: At work, this is crisp strategy, editing, legal/contractual rigor, and saying no to scope creep. Rely on clear criteria rather than office politics.
career.zh: 在工作上，她代表利落的策略裁剪、条款严谨与对需求蔓延的干脆拒绝。用明确标准说话，而不是卷入职场揣测。

health.en: For wellbeing, look at your habits and symptoms objectively—track real data or seek a second expert opinion instead of brushing issues aside.
health.zh: 在健康与精力管理上，客观记录真实数据或寻求专业第二意见，别靠侥幸把反复出现的问题糊弄过去。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, discernment itself is wisdom: seeing reality clearly without wishful illusions frees energy for what is true.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，清明辨识本身即是智慧：放下自我安慰的幻觉如实观照，才能把力量留给真正重要之事。

core.en: Queen of Swords reversed signals clouded objectivity—either sharp bitterness is turning discernment into cynicism, or old hurt is making it hard to set a clear boundary.
core.zh: 宝剑王后逆位提示清明度受情绪波及——要么过往委屈让犀利变成冷嘲与防备，要么心软迟疑让你迟迟划不出清晰边界。

blocked.en: Swallowing an important truth to keep false peace, leaving resentment to simmer.
blocked.zh: 为了维持表面和平把真话咽回肚子，反而让积怨暗自发酵。

excess.en: Cutting people off preemptively or using razor sarcasm as armor against vulnerability.
excess.zh: 先发制人地冷处理，或拿尖锐讽刺当盾牌来遮掩脆弱。

internalized.en: Turning that merciless inner critic entirely onto yourself.
internalized.zh: 把毫不留情的严苛审视全都对准了自己。

release.en: Softening defensive armor without giving up hard-won wisdom.
release.zh: 卸下过度戒备的硬壳，同时保住历经世事修来的清醒判断。

challenge.en: Unprocessed hurt is coloring your read of someone's motives—either assuming the worst too fast or tolerating blurred lines too long.
challenge.zh: 尚未消化的旧伤正在左右你对他人动机的判断——要么过快往坏处定性，要么对模糊越界忍让太久。

action.en: Draft the blunt message, let it sit ten minutes, strip out the sting, and send only the clear boundary.
action.zh: 把犀利的话先写下来放十分钟，删掉带刺的情绪词，只发出清晰坚定的边界。

general.en: Check whether your edge is protecting clarity or defending an old bruise. Speak plainly without punishing.
general.zh: 宝剑王后逆位提醒你先确认自己的锋芒是在守护清晰，还是在护着一道旧伤。把事实与底线说清楚即可，不必带着惩罚或尖刻语气。

love.en: In love, reversed Queen of Swords cautions against icy withdrawal, keeping score, or testing a partner instead of stating what hurt.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑王后逆位提醒警惕冷战疏离、暗自记账，或用带刺的试探反复考验伴侣，却始终不肯坦白真正令你受伤的痛点。

career.en: At work, beware hyper-critical feedback that shuts teammates down, or letting personal bias distort an evaluation. Return to concrete evidence.
career.zh: 在职场上，避免过度挑剔或居高临下的措辞把协作者推远，也警惕个人成见左右评审判断，重新回到客观可验证的事实依据上。

health.en: Notice where harsh self-talk or mental rumination is adding tension; give your nervous system space to decompress.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，留意严苛的自我批判、过度思虑与紧绷的戒备感是否在持续消耗睡眠与精力，给神经系统留出真正的缓冲空间。

spirituality.en: Release the belief that staying guarded equals staying wise; open perception sees further than suspicion.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，放下必须时刻戒备才算清醒的执念；敞开、沉静而温和的洞察力，往往比处处设防的猜疑看得更透彻、更长远。

promptSpec.suitAccent: crisp ice-silver, storm-slate blue, luminous moonlit ivory, burnished antique gold
promptSpec.scene: A regal, lucid Belle Epoque Queen seated in sharp three-quarter profile upon a high carved pale-stone throne set above windswept silver-blue twilight clouds. Her posture is upright, poised, and sovereign. In her right hand, she holds EXACTLY ONE long, straight, gleaming engraved silver-and-antique-gold SWORD perfectly vertical, blade bright and unmistakable against the midnight sky. Her left hand is gracefully raised outward in calm discernment and clear boundary. She wears a sculptural slate-blue and silver-embroidered silk gown with crisp ivory collar highlights and a delicate silver-gold filigree diadem. Subtle Art Nouveau moths and wind-swept cloud spirals are carved into the pale limestone throne, with a single lone bird soaring high in the bright pale silver moonlit sky.

requiredObjects.object: upright straight silver-gold sword held in right hand

promptSpec.compositionNote: Razor-clear vertical silver sword blade and luminous profile silhouette cut cleanly across negative cloud space so the Queen + vertical sword read instantly at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Sovereign, principled intellect—delivering impartial judgment and strategic command unshaken by noise.
archetypeEssence.zh: 沉稳笃定的原则权威——不为噪音与私心所动，以公正理智立定大局。

en: Composed King seated squarely facing forward upon a tall carved stone throne
One straight upright sword held firmly in his right hand tilted slightly at calm attention
Deep blue tunic and royal slate-violet mantle denoting intellectual discipline and ethics
Butterflies and crescent moons carved cleanly into the high throne back
Still towering clouds, twin soaring birds, and upright cypresses framing a lucid horizon
zh: 正面端坐于高背雕花石座、神情沉静威严的国王
右手沉稳竖握、微斜戒备的一柄雪亮直剑
象征严谨理智与法度原则的深蓝内袍与灰紫披风
高耸石座靠背上精致雕刻的蝶翼与新月浮雕
高空沉静云层、双飞高鸟与挺立柏树映出的开阔视野

en: Commanding Belle Epoque King seated squarely front-facing on a monumental carved pale-limestone throne above serene high-altitude twilight clouds
Exactly one broad, straight, gleaming frost-silver and antique-gold sword held upright at a subtle poised tilt in his right hand
Sculptural midnight-cobalt tunic, draped storm-slate and deep-plum velvet mantle, and architectural antique-gold circlet crown
Intricate Art Nouveau butterflies and silver crescent moons etched into the tall rectangular throne back, flanked by two dark upright cypresses
Two distant birds gliding smoothly across crisp moonlit silver air above the King's steady, impartial gaze
zh: 端坐于高空静云之上雕花浅石王座、正面平视前方的威严美好年代国王
右手稳稳握持、笔直微倾的一柄霜银古金阔刃直剑
深钴蓝修身礼袍、风暴灰与暗紫丝绒披风以及规整古金冠冕
高背方正石座上精雕的新艺术蝶纹与银月浮雕，两侧挺立两株暗色柏树
清朗月色高空中振翅滑翔的两只远景飞鸟，呼应国王沉稳公正的凝视

core.en: King of Swords embodies mature analytical authority: apply fair standards consistently, think three moves ahead, and decide from clear evidence and ethics rather than impulse or favoritism.
core.zh: 宝剑国王体现成熟沉稳的理智权威：始终如一地执行公正标准、提前想清三步后的格局，依据事实与原则拍板，而不被情绪或私情牵着走。

message.en: Step into executive clarity—set objective criteria, seek expert counsel if needed, and make the fair call cleanly.
message.zh: 拿出一锤定音的清明格局——立定客观标准，必要时请教顶尖专业人士，干脆利落地作出公正裁决。

foundation.en: Strict standards, seasoned expertise, or a clear framework of rules established the structure you are operating inside.
foundation.zh: 严谨的规则意识、长期沉淀的专业口碑或明确的制度框架，搭起了如今运行的基础。

present.en: This situation calls for cool headship: rise above emotional noise, examine the whole system, and hold everyone—including yourself—to the same standard.
present.zh: 当下需要能镇住场面的冷静统领：跳出情绪噪音，从全局审视机制，对包括自己在内的所有人执行同一把尺子。

resource.en: Your leverage lies in unshakable reasoning and credibility—whether your own mastery or a seasoned advisor, lawyer, architect, or mentor in your corner.
resource.zh: 你手里最硬的倚仗是站得住脚的逻辑与公信力——既可以是你自身的专业积淀，也可以是身边那位值得信赖的资深专家、法务或导师。

challenge.en: Even upright, King of Swords in a challenge slot asks whether austere logic is leaving out human warmth or turning reasonable standards into an unapproachable wall.
challenge.zh: 即便是正位，落在阻碍位的宝剑国王也在提醒：一丝不苟的理性是否遗漏了人情温度，或把原本合理的标准垒成了难以靠近的高墙？

action.en: Define the governing principle in writing, review the key facts systematically, and deliver a firm, transparent decision with zero ambiguity.
action.zh: 把核心原则白纸黑字立清，系统核查全部关键事实，随后给出明确透明、毫无含糊的最终拍板。

outcome.en: Order, sound governance, and lasting respect follow—a clean ruling or disciplined strategy holds steady under scrutiny.
outcome.zh: 秩序、稳健的治理与长久敬重随之落定——一份经得起检验的裁定或战略布局将稳稳站住。

advice.en: Lead with ethics as well as intellect—the sharpest authority earns trust because its rules protect fairness, not ego.
advice.zh: 把道义与理智一同握在手里——最高级的权威之所以令人信服，是因为它的规则守护公正，而非只服务于面子。

general.en: Disciplined reasoning, ethical consistency, and strategic altitude resolve this cleanly. Let verified principles govern the outcome.
general.zh: 严谨思辨、表里如一的原则与全局高度能干净解开此局。让经得起验证的准则主导最终走向。

love.en: In love, King of Swords values integrity, reliability, and clear commitments over theatrical promises. Show care through fairness and kept words, while remembering to let warmth show too.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑国王看重守信、坦荡与清晰承诺，远胜华丽誓言。用公平担当与说到做到表达爱意，同时也别忘了留出柔软温度。

career.en: At work, this is executive leadership, sound architecture, legal or financial rigor, and impartial governance. Rely on transparent metrics and seasoned expertise.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，他代表高阶统筹、扎实架构、法务与风控严谨以及公正决策。依靠透明标准与专业深度稳步推进。

health.en: For wellbeing, take an informed, structured approach—consult qualified specialists when needed and follow a clear, evidence-backed routine steadily.
health.zh: 在身心管理上，适合采取理性而系统的方法——必要时请教专业人士，并稳步执行有据可依的规律方案。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, this is sovereignty of mind: observing passions without being swept away, aligning thought, speech, and action in quiet integrity.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，宝剑国王代表心智的清明主权：如实觉察情绪起伏却不被裹挟，让所思、所言与所行在静定诚实中合而为一。

core.en: King of Swords reversed warns of distorted authority—either weaponizing sharp logic to dominate and control, or abdicating judgment into icy detachment and drift.
core.zh: 宝剑国王逆位警示权威失衡——要么把精明逻辑当成压迫与操控他人的工具，要么陷入冷漠抽离，在需要拍板时放弃担当。

blocked.en: Withholding a needed decision out of detachment or fear of being accountable for the ruling.
blocked.zh: 因过度抽离或不想替后果担责，迟迟不肯作出该由你下的决断。

excess.en: Rigid authoritarianism, intellectual arrogance, or twisting technicalities to win at others' expense.
excess.zh: 居高临下的强硬专断、智力傲慢，或钻规则空子压制别人。

internalized.en: Policing your own feelings with a cold internal magistrate that leaves zero room for vulnerability.
internalized.zh: 在心里安了一位冷冰冰的法官时刻审查自己的情绪，绝不允许一丝脆弱露面。

release.en: Stepping down from rigid control and letting fair dialogue replace unilateral decrees.
release.zh: 从僵硬控制中退一步，用平等透明的讨论取代独断发令。

challenge.en: Either someone is hiding bias behind cold logic, or lack of clear leadership is letting bad structure slide unchecked.
challenge.zh: 要么有人正拿冷静逻辑包装私心与偏见，要么缺少明确主心骨，任由松散规则持续失序。

action.en: Audit the logic for hidden self-interest, invite one honest check on your blind spots, and enforce fairness without bullying.
action.zh: 先检查推论背后有没有夹带私心，主动听取一位敢讲真话者的校验，在不压人的前提下守住公道。

outcome.en: Resentment or stalled direction builds if control replaces fairness; resetting transparency restores respect quickly.
outcome.zh: 若继续拿控制替代公正，只会积攒抵触或让方向失焦；重新立起透明原则，信任很快便能修复。

advice.en: Check your motives before citing the rulebook—real authority serves the truth rather than winning compliance.
advice.zh: 搬出规则之前先检视自己的动机——真正的权威服务于事实，而不是用来逼人顺从。

general.en: Watch for manipulative rhetoric, rigid control, or detached indecision. Anchor back in transparent facts and humble accountability.
general.zh: 警惕精致却带私心的说辞、僵化控制或冷眼旁观式的推诿。重新锚定在透明事实与坦荡担当上。

love.en: In love, reversed King of Swords warns against intellectualizing away hurt feelings, lecturing a partner, or using cold silence to keep the upper hand.
love.zh: 在感情中，宝剑国王逆位提醒警惕拿讲道理掩盖情感冷漠、居高临下说教，或用冰冷沉默维持关系里的控制权。

career.en: At work, look out for micromanagement, weaponized policy, biased reviews, or leadership ducking tough calls. Keep every commitment documented and objective.
career.zh: 在职场上，留意过度管控、拿制度卡人、夹带私心的评审，或管理者回避关键拍板。把关键承诺落于客观记录。

health.en: Rigid self-policing or ignoring bodily signals because they do not fit your schedule backfires; temper discipline with real responsiveness.
health.zh: 过度刻板的自律，或因“不在计划内”而无视身体疲惫信号，终究适得其反；给克制配上真诚倾听身体的弹性。

spirituality.en: Intellect without compassion turns brittle; soften the urge to judge everything from a high perch and reconnect with lived humility.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，失去悲悯的理智终将变得干硬脆弱；从居高临下的评判席上走下来，重新连接踏实谦逊的日常。
